COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
BA1 No.2246 of 2021
Hon'ble R.C. Khulbe, J.
 Mr. Abhishek Verma, learned counsel for the
applicant.
 Mr. Deepak Bisht, learned B.H. for the State.
Accused-Anoop Padrinath Dormale has
sought his release on bail in connection with Case
Crime/FIR No.184/2020 u/s 420, 120-B of IPC,
registered at P.S. Cantt, District Dehradun.
As per the FIR dated 02.11.2020, the
informant submitted an application through online
in the linked website for getting job as the senior
manager. Anoop Padrinath fixed the date for
interview. The informant appeared for interview
through video conferencing. Thereafter, he received
a mail regarding his job. The informant submitted
all the documents as desired. Accordingly, the
informant also submitted his passport. Thereafter,
they demanded Rs.8,75,000/-. Accordingly, as per
the instructions, the informant transferred
Rs.8,75,000/-. Thereafter, they switched off their
mobile phone and the informant submitted
information with police station Cantt. on
02.11.2020.
It is argued that the accused has been falsely
implicated; he is languishing in jail since
17.07.2021; he did not receive any money; no TIP
was conducted; he is ready to furnish the sureties
and may be granted bail.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State
opposed for bail and submitted that, as per the
record collected during the investigation, the
informant transferred Rs.8,75,000/- in the account
of cousin of the present accused. The informant
appeared before for the interview through virtual
mode.
The accused is languishing in jail since
17.07.2021; he has three criminal history of similar
nature of offence; as per the document collected
during the investigation, the informant transferred

Rs.8,75,000/- in the account of cousin of the present
accused; the accused has sent a message regarding
the service through his email to the informant; the
interview was conducted by some Shrikant, who
was related to the present accused, accordingly,
looking to the gravity of the offence, it is not a fit
case for bail at this stage.
The bail application is thus, dismissed.
Pending application, if any, stands disposed
of.
 (R.C. Khulbe, J.)
 30.09.2021
